observations.summary: Owner praises the vacuum but reports hidden lower popup controls preventing task cancellation and no-go-zone editing during repeated furniture-entry attempts.
observations.uncertainty: Historical report; robot model, phone, app version and current resolution unknown. It does not establish failure of a physical emergency stop.
observations.proposed_test: Vary display scaling, safe areas, orientation and accessibility settings; measure reachable cancel control, acknowledged halt latency and independent local stop access.

observations.summary: Otherwise favorable owner review reports phone heating after several minutes with the app open.
observations.uncertainty: Historical phone-side burden, not robot battery failure. Current persistence is unknown; see the separate claimed fix.
observations.proposed_test: Compare phone temperature and energy use against an idle-app baseline on matched devices; retain control-latency measurements.

observations.summary: Developer release notes claim reduced overheating and map-rendering improvements.
observations.uncertainty: Fix claim, not independent confirmation. Relative date in the fetched page is not a verified release timestamp.
observations.proposed_test: Repeat the same phone-resource test before and after this version.

observations.summary: Owner likes the vacuum and functioning app but reports recurring upgrade or trade-in prompts after reopening the app.
observations.uncertainty: No measured stop blockage or verified opt-out state. App version and robot model unspecified.
observations.proposed_test: Measure promotional interruptions, dismissals and time to cleaning/stop controls; test persistent opt-out without suppressing safety notifications.

observations.summary: Owner reports repeated marketing sign-up prompts despite liking the robot.
observations.uncertainty: Historical complaint; exact settings, region and version missing. A newer reviewer reports no ads.
observations.proposed_test: Compare promotion settings across regions and versions; count interruptions per intended robot action.

observations.locator: September 15 review: no ads and stable use
observations.summary: Reviewer reports no ads, possibly after changing a setting, and smooth use without crashes after initial lag.
observations.uncertainty: Self-report and setting uncertain; not proof that earlier complaints were false or globally fixed.
observations.proposed_test: Retain this counterexample when testing opt-outs and configuration differences.

observations.locator: Narwal Flow 2: hair balls and damaged floor
observations.summary: Owner reports debris clumps, floor scratches, manual cleanup and docking or emptying trouble.
observations.uncertainty: Incident and cause unverified. September 27 is the experience date, not a verified publication date. Read through business profile.
observations.proposed_test: Measure net debris removal, return-path residue, assessed surface-damage proxies and human rework across the full mission.

observations.summary: S8 MaxV Ultra owner reports persistent Error 42 and repeated exchanges without a clear total repair price or complete service terms.
observations.uncertainty: Owner account only; no independent diagnosis, complete support correspondence or legal finding.
observations.proposed_test: Measure time and contacts needed for a complete repair decision: price range, shipping, turnaround, warranty and fallback options.

observations.summary: Owner describes an otherwise functional app but reports version 3.4.6 crashes when accessed from multiple devices.
observations.uncertainty: Historical version-specific allegation; concurrency mechanism and current behavior unverified. Do not transfer to the separate eufy app.
observations.proposed_test: Test two authorized controllers, session changes and conflicting requests; preserve deterministic command ownership and stop access.

observations.locator: February 17 review: delayed connect and cancellation
observations.summary: Owner reports long connection waits and additional delay cancelling a robot that becomes stuck.
observations.uncertainty: Classic app only. Reported delays are not independently timed; network and server causes unknown.
observations.proposed_test: Measure end-to-end cancel acknowledgement under normal and impaired connectivity, with a local stop fallback.

observations.summary: Owner reports useful time savings and no entrapment in tight spaces.
observations.uncertainty: Single positive profile review; operating exposure and long-term reliability not established.
observations.proposed_test: Include successful missions and intervention-free operation in representative sampling.

observations.locator: August 26 review: setup recovery and early success
observations.summary: Owner reports resolving initial connection trouble by a power cycle, followed by two successful vacuuming runs without entrapment.
observations.uncertainty: Very short self-reported exposure; not evidence of long-horizon reliability or independent product comparison.
observations.proposed_test: Record setup intervention separately from subsequent success; do not lose positive control cases.

observations.summary: Generally enthusiastic Freo X Ultra owner requests easier access to abort or delay scheduled cleaning during activities such as work calls.
observations.uncertainty: Historical usability request, not verified cancellation failure or a measured current-version defect.
observations.proposed_test: Measure steps and elapsed time to defer an accepted schedule or recall the robot without removing useful alerts.

observations.summary: Reviewer likes the robot but finds the new app less easy to use than the old one.
observations.uncertainty: App identities, migration date and robot model unknown; no operational failure established. Read through business profile.
observations.proposed_test: Compare task completion time and preserved settings before and after a verified app migration.
